title: Nutty Roasted Irish Beef Roast
description: A rich and savory Irish beef roast with crunchy nut topping, perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: Season the beef roast with salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the beef roast until browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the beef from the pot and set it aside.
Add the sliced onions to the pot and cook until they start to caramelize, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced carrots and potatoes to the pot and cook for another 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Sprinkle the gluten-free flour over the vegetables and stir to combine.
Gradually add the beef broth to the pot, stirring constantly to prevent lumps.
Return the beef roast to the pot and bring the mixture to a boil.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and roast the beef for 20 minutes per pound, or until it reaches your desired level of doneness.
Meanwhile, toast the chopped walnuts in a small skillet over medium heat, stirring frequently, until fragrant and lightly browned.
Remove the pot from the oven and brush the beef roast with the toasted walnuts.
Return the pot to the oven and roast for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the beef is nicely browned and the internal temperature reaches 135°F (57°C) for medium-rare.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing the beef and serving.
Garnish with chopped fresh rosemary and serve hot.
